teaser: Spreadsheet to App: a session programme for Algarve Evolution, with five examples, five prompts, a mock event and a public vault.
core_idea: A session programme with one premise, turn your spreadsheet into an application, and two requirements, a model that can build an app and a spreadsheet with publishable dummy data; people arrive with the problem written down or pick one of five invented examples, five prompts take it from a searchable list to a published app, a mock day hands each app to someone else and teaches the handover, apps are published from each tool, a GitHub repository per participant, or moved by a team of providers; the apps that later break are the market.
